props.name: value
props.description: Controlled HTML. Sanitised on the way in, so it may come from anywhere.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with sanitised HTML after every edit. An empty document is ''.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the text box and its toolbar.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown while the document is empty.

props.name: minHeight
props.description: Height of the writing area before it grows, in pixels.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks editing and dims the toolbar.

props.name: 'aria-describedby'
props.description: Ids of elements that describe the text box — a hint, an error.
